research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Publication scope
verified_claims: The accredited publication covers offender management statistics for October to December 2025, annual 2025 figures, and the prison population at 31 March 2026.
limitations: The publication is for England and Wales and does not provide parcel-level or exact-address evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Prison population total
verified_claims: The prison population was 87,342 on 31 March 2026, around 1% lower than at the same point in 2025.
limitations: A national custody total cannot identify local public-safety conditions at a parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Sentenced population
verified_claims: The sentenced prison population was 70,829, representing 81% of the total on 31 March 2026.
limitations: Custody composition is not a geographic risk score.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Remand population
verified_claims: The remand prison population was 16,025, representing 18% of the total on 31 March 2026.
limitations: The remand population cannot be attributed to any neighbourhood or property.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Non-criminal population
verified_claims: The non-criminal prison population was 488, representing 1% of the total on 31 March 2026.
limitations: This aggregate category does not support parcel inference.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: August 2025 month-end high
verified_claims: The month-end prison population reached 88,423 at the end of August 2025.
limitations: A national month-end peak is not evidence of local incident exposure.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: September 2025 population
verified_claims: The prison population was 87,465 at the end of September 2025 after falling by around 1,000 from August.
limitations: The month-to-month national movement does not identify local causation.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Remand annual change
verified_claims: The remand population decreased by 9% between 31 March 2025 and 31 March 2026.
limitations: The annual change is system-level and not suitable for parcel scoring.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Untried remand population
verified_claims: The untried remand population was 10,585 on 31 March 2026, down 7% from March 2025.
limitations: Pre-conviction custody statistics must not be interpreted as neighbourhood crime prevalence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Convicted unsentenced remand
verified_claims: The convicted unsentenced remand population was 5,440 on 31 March 2026, down 13% from March 2025.
limitations: The figure is an institutional caseload measure, not an address-level measure.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Remand offence groups
verified_claims: Violence against the person and drug offences were the two largest offence groups among people held on remand.
limitations: Offence-group composition in custody cannot establish risk around a particular parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Remand ethnicity comparison
verified_claims: White prisoners comprised 73% of the sentenced population and 64% of the remand population.
limitations: Demographic proportions must not be used to infer risk about individuals, groups, or locations.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Sentenced annual change
verified_claims: The sentenced population increased by 1% compared with March 2025.
limitations: The change is national and cannot be mapped to a property.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Mid-length sentence growth
verified_claims: Populations serving 12 months to less than 2 years and 2 years to less than 4 years each increased by 11% from the previous year.
limitations: Sentence-length changes do not indicate local safety conditions.
